product_metadata.title: Exclusivo Mezcla Queen Size Flannel Fleece Velvet Plush Bed Blanket as Bedspread, Coverlet, Bed Cover (90x90 inches, Celadon) Soft, Lightweight, Warm and Cozy
features: Soft flannel fleece: The fabric we choose for this throw blanket is premium flannel fleece which is from 100% microfiber polyester and brushed to create extra softness on both sides. The antistatic finish will effectively improve the situation of statics.

Versatile: This premium bed blanket can be a very useful item to have on hand. Enough weight to keep you comfortable, yet light enough to keep you from breaking out in sweat, suitable for all seasons.

Decorative: With the velvet touch softness and elegant designs, the blanket features a double-faced plush with graceful luster, and the textured waffle pattern offers a unique silhouette and modern look. Easily coordinates or enhances existing bedding or home décor.
Durable: Made of premium flannel, this flannel fleece blanket is super soft, durable, warm and lightweight. It's wrinkle and fade resistant, doesn't shed, and is suitable for all seasons.
Easy care: It is machine washable and dryable for easy care. No shrinkage, No colour fading, and No unravelling after washing.
